purpose: Define rendezvous/signaling services as explicit bootstrap coordination identities separate from payload transport, application server and peer authority.

topics.name: Rendezvous Service Identity
topics.purpose: Define rendezvous/signaling services as explicit bootstrap coordination identities separate from payload transport, application server and peer authority.

semantics.identity_rule: Each rendezvous/signaling service has an explicit identity.
semantics.role_rule: Service coordinates peer discovery/signaling only according to declared profile.
semantics.payload_rule: Normal application payload remains P2P where protocol requires; rendezvous is not semantic payload owner.
semantics.authority_rule: Rendezvous registration does not grant peer/application authority.
semantics.availability_rule: Service availability is separate from peer reachability.

invariants.rule: Listener, route, endpoint, connection, channel, peer reachability and cryptographic transport evidence never by themselves grant application, data or operation authority.
Inbound network data remains inert until explicit protocol parsing, validation, identity/context resolution, authorization and dispatcher routing succeed.

signaling service owns peer data semantics
